title: Modeling Balloon Volume as a Composite Function of Time
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A weather balloon's volume V (in cm^3) depends on the ambient temperature s (in degrees Celsius) according to V(s) = s^2 + 2s + 3. The ambient temperature at time t minutes is given by s(t) = 2t - 3 degrees Celsius. Express the balloon's volume V as a function of time t.

steps.title: Formulate the Composite Function V(s(t))
steps.explanation: Substitute the temperature-time relation s(t) = 2t - 3 in place of s throughout the volume formula V(s) = s^2 + 2s + 3.
steps.why: Chaining a physical quantity V(s) with time dependence s(t) is modeled by the composition (V o s)(t).

steps.title: Expand the Binomial Square and Linear Term
steps.explanation: Expand (2t - 3)^2 = 4t^2 - 12t + 9 and distribute 2 across (2t - 3) to get 4t - 6.
steps.why: Applying the binomial square identity (a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2 and distributive law.

steps.title: Combine Like Terms in Powers of t
steps.explanation: Combine the linear terms -12t + 4t = -8t and the constant terms 9 - 6 + 3 = 6 to obtain V(t) = 4t^2 - 8t + 6.
steps.why: Collecting like powers of t puts the quadratic polynomial in standard form.
